title: Allow the owning Merger to consume a full-gate result independently of its notification recipient
outcome: A completed full-gate result remains attached to its run and frozen input and can be waited on/consumed by its owning Merger even if completion notification went to a different session.
acceptance: Gate result lookup/wait authorization uses the run and its owning package/input association; notification routing does not make a valid result inaccessible to the owning Merger.
A regression reproduces different producer, notification target and owning Merger and verifies correct result consumption and rejection of an unrelated run/input/session.

New and relevant focused tests pass, an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher findings, and the exact patch/package with test and review evidence is handed to Merger under Greg's simplified flow.
